provenance: Adversarial statement/definition review after the source freeze. Prepared all 41 Shared typing packets, read the 288 unique required input snapshots (76 unit bodies, 211 Lean declarations/example propositions, and policy), checked selected content against frozen source, and inspected relevant source definitions for example setups, embeddings, and implicit assumptions. Identical required snapshots shared across packets were read once. The reviewer authored runtime path/promotion infrastructure and strengthened the permission_paths example; this is not an author-independent review. Earlier audit findings were resolved before these packets were prepared.
rationale: Pattern has only variable and unpack(className, named destinations); Statement pairs a pattern with a Value. Freshness, destination distinctness and exact field coverage are checked by the binding relation rather than embedded in raw syntax, as the chapter describes. Notation and judgment context: unit:given.patterns. Their full unit bodies and cited definitions were inspected alongside this unit; finite-map, signed-view, and normalized-type conventions are inherited where referenced.
limitations: This review compares prose and mathematics with definitions and theorem/example statements, including assumptions and example setup. It does not independently re-prove Lean proofs or replace a mechanical execution receipt. Additional full-source keys identify the context consulted for those definitions, not an audit of every proof in those files.
